features: HD Projection, Supports 4K Video Playback & Stereo Sound: Supports 4K video playback via USB drive for smooth viewing. High quality optical lens delivers clear images and is scratch resistant and easy to clean. Built-in stereo speakers provide clear sound for movies, TV shows and casual games, ideal for use as a telephone projector.

Dynamic starry sky mode and 180° rotating design: activate the dynamic starry sky mode with one-touch control on the remote control. With 9 animated starry sky scenes and a built-in sleep timer, the projector for bedroom displays dynamic star patterns on the ceiling to create a soothing sleeping atmosphere for children. The 180° rotating design allows you to easily adjust the angle for wall or ceiling projection.

Ultra portable mini projector for indoor and outdoor use: weighs only 0.35 kg with a compact size of 3.73 × 3.73 × 15.7 cm. EASY TO CARRY IN A BACKPACK - Perfect for camping, travel, dorm room, bedroom, outdoor movie nights and small apartments.
description: Auto keystone, dual focus and big screen projection: supports automatic and manual focus for quick and precise image adjustment. Automatic vertical keystone correction delivers a perfectly aligned image in seconds. The short throw ratio of 0.9:1 allows large screen projection in a small space and supports 30-200 inch screen sizes (recommended 40-100 inches).
